data.summary: Mid-America Apartment Communities (MAA) intègre l'IA/ML de manière opérationnelle dans ses produits, opérations ou processus selon son 10-K, sans en faire son coeur d'identité.

evidence.quote: The rapid evolution and increased adoption of artificial intelligence technologies, by us and our third-party service providers, may also heighten our cybersecurity risks by making cyber attacks more difficult to detect, contain and mitigate.
Our business continues and will continue to demand the use of sophisticated systems, software and technology, including artificial intelligence.
